In this video, we talk about how an ordinary plumber, Captain Smit Machchhar and two off-duty pilots onboard worked together in a situation where hundreds of lives were at risk.
What makes this story unusual is that one of the people who stepped in was not a trained pilot or aviation expert, but a normal passenger. Along with Captain Smit Machchhar, other passengers, crew members and the pilots travelling onboard, he became part of the effort that helped bring the situation under control and prevent a much bigger incident.
